x: Geoff Barker was second in the 100 yards Senior and Dicky Bartlett won a straight 220 yards Senior. Ian Badiali won the 880 yards in 2min. 0.8secs. with Don Maclean in third place, while Bill Lucas beat Len Adams in the Senior mile after a good race with Fieldsend of Mitcham A.C.

Unfortunately, owing to holidays, etc., we were minus the services of Walden and Holtum, and as both Sexton and Bartlett were required for the 4 x 440, it was decided not to field a team for the sprint relay.

Dicky Bartlett ran 3rd in the 220 yds., which was won by Brian Shenton, and then came the sensation of the meeting, McDonald Bailey could only finish 3rd in the 100 yds. and was beaten by Ruddy of A.P.M., and our own Ron Holtum in 10.1 secs.
Unfortunately he does not get the credit, for Bartlett of Coventry was in devastating form and ran even faster to become the first man under 21 mins for this leg.
With Heatley and Kilby both in form again and Bartlett and Lancaster to join their winning 'National' team (9 in 117) they should be a stronger force than last year's winning dozen.

John Stow, recovering from tonsilitis, hardly treated stage six like a convalescent's outing for he took us up two places overtaking Bartlett of Birchfield and Collins of Hercules Wimbledon in the process.
